operator_message: Operator requested comprehensive 6-layer audit of POS app + cross-portal integration on 2026-03-15. 6 parallel agents audited: UI/UX, API/Middleware, DB/Migrations, Cross-Portal, Business Logic, GCP Parity. 59 findings (3 CRITICAL, 10 HIGH, 29 MEDIUM, 17 LOW) registered as STG-493 to STG-551. All 492 previous tickets marked PARKED. Awaiting operator approval to begin implementation.
guard_version: fix-guard v6 (14 pre-commit gates + 10-layer full verification audit)
full_verification_description: Source-code-level audit of ALL 492 tickets across 10 mandatory verification layers. No ticket is VERIFIED until ALL applicable layers pass from source code inspection — not machine state, not tags, not stub tests.

mandatory_verification_layers._description: Every ticket MUST pass ALL applicable layers. Each layer is verified from SOURCE CODE, not machine state. VERIFIED status requires evidence from the codebase.

V1_UI_UX.name: UI/UX Elements
checks: All UI elements from ticket spec exist in source (buttons, inputs, labels, cards, modals)
Theme tokens used (no hardcoded colors except documented rgba overlays)
fontSize >= 11 for all body/caption text
Proper spacing using theme.spacing constants
accessibilityLabel on all interactive elements
accessibilityRole correct (button/checkbox/text/link)
accessibilityState for stateful controls (checked, disabled, selected)
V1_UI_UX.verification_method: grep + file read of affected .tsx files

V2_NAVIGATION.name: Navigation & Flow
checks: Android BackHandler support (hardware back button)
onBack prop or navigation.goBack() wired
Safe area handling (useSafeAreaInsets) on all screens
No dead-end screens (every screen has exit path)
Modal dismiss handlers exist
Deep link / route params handled correctly
V2_NAVIGATION.verification_method: grep for BackHandler, useSafeAreaInsets, onBack in each screen

V3_WIRING.name: Wiring (UI → API → State)
checks: Every onPress/onSubmit calls a real function (not empty/console.log/TODO)
API calls use apiClient with proper endpoints
State updates after API success (setData, setLoading, setError)
Loading state set before API call, cleared in finally block
Error state set on API failure with user-visible message
No dangling promises (async handlers properly awaited)
V3_WIRING.verification_method: read onPress handlers, trace to API call, verify state updates

V4_API_BACKEND.name: API & Backend Routes
checks: Frontend API call matches backend route definition
Route has auth middleware (requireAuth/requireStaff)
Request validation (required fields checked)
Response format matches frontend expectations
Error responses use proper HTTP status codes
No internal error details leaked to client
V4_API_BACKEND.verification_method: trace frontend apiClient calls to backend route handlers

V5_DB_TABLES.name: Database & Store Isolation
checks: ALL queries include WHERE store_id = $token.storeId
storeId derived from JWT only (NEVER from req.body/req.query)
Parameterized queries (no string concatenation for SQL)
Transactions used for multi-table operations
Migrations are sequential, idempotent, and reversible
No schema conflicts between migration files
V5_DB_TABLES.applies_to: ALL tickets with DB queries or migrations
V5_DB_TABLES.verification_method: grep for store_id in queries, check migration sequence

V6_GCP_STAGING_PARITY.name: GCP Staging Parity
checks: No hardcoded localhost/127.0.0.1 in production code paths
Docker builds use production commands (not dev servers)
Environment variables used for all config (not hardcoded)
CI/CD pipeline covers all services
Health check endpoints exist and respond
Deployed SHA matches HEAD of main
V6_GCP_STAGING_PARITY.applies_to: ALL tickets — staging must match local
V6_GCP_STAGING_PARITY.verification_method: grep for localhost in src/, check Dockerfiles and CI configs

V7_BUSINESS_LOGIC.name: Business Logic Invariants
checks: Stock can never go negative without explicit override
Financial amounts use minor units (paise) with integer arithmetic
Prices cannot be set below zero
Discounts cannot exceed 100% or item price
Payment totals must equal bill total
Ledger entries are balanced (debit = credit)
V7_BUSINESS_LOGIC.verification_method: read business logic functions, trace calculations

V8_EDGE_CASES.name: Edge Cases & UX States
checks: Loading state shown during API calls
Error state with retry option on API failure
Empty state with guidance when no data
Offline handling (banner, graceful degradation)
Form validation with user-friendly error messages
Concurrent submission prevention (disable button during loading)
Large dataset handling (FlatList virtualization, pagination)
V8_EDGE_CASES.applies_to: ALL tickets with data fetching or user input
V8_EDGE_CASES.verification_method: read screen render logic for all 4 UX states

V9_I18N.name: Internationalization
checks: All user-visible strings use t() translation function
Every en.json key has corresponding hi.json key
No empty string values in either locale file
Hindi translations are actual Hindi (not English placeholders)
Date/time/currency formatting uses locale-aware functions
No hardcoded English text in .tsx render output
V9_I18N.verification_method: compare en.json and hi.json keys, grep for hardcoded strings

V10_GIT_DISCIPLINE.name: Git Discipline & Zero Regression
checks: One ticket = one commit (Gate 11 enforced)
Commit message format: type(STG-XXX): description
Co-Authored-By line present
Max 15 source files per commit (Gate 12)
TypeScript typecheck passes (Gate 13)
Fix ledger checksums intact (Gate 1)
No broken imports or missing dependencies
No regression in existing test suite
V10_GIT_DISCIPLINE.verification_method: git log analysis, tsc --noEmit, fix-guard check

mandatory_per_ticket_gates._description: Every ticket MUST pass ALL applicable gates before parking. Gate 14 BLOCKS commit if any checklist item is incomplete.

LAYER_A_UI_UX.applies_to: POS screens, portal pages, theme files, i18n files
LAYER_A_UI_UX.enforcement: MANDATORY — N/A only for pure backend tickets with zero UI impact

LAYER_B_API_BACKEND.enforcement: MANDATORY — N/A only for pure frontend cosmetic tickets

LAYER_C_BUSINESS.applies_to: ALL tickets — every change affects behaviour
LAYER_C_BUSINESS.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket must verify end-to-end workflow

LAYER_D_DB.applies_to: Tickets with migrations or DB query changes
LAYER_D_DB.enforcement: MANDATORY when DB touched — N/A for UI-only tickets

LAYER_E_DRIFT_SAFETY.applies_to: ALL tickets — prevents multi-agent drift and regression
LAYER_E_DRIFT_SAFETY.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket must verify zero drift and no agent conflicts

LAYER_F_GCP_PARITY.applies_to: ALL tickets — staging compatibility and test coverage
LAYER_F_GCP_PARITY.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket needs tests and GCP compatibility

LAYER_G_GIT.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket = one commit = one tag = PARKED
